title: Government of India Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) Scheme Rules
source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) is a government-backed savings scheme for the financial benefit of girl children. Accounts can be opened by natural parents/legal guardians for a girl child under the age of 10 years (maximum 2 accounts per family). Maximum annual contribution limit is ₹1,50,000. Contributions qualify for Section 80C deduction, and interest/maturity proceeds are 100% tax-free. Account matures after 21 years from account opening date.
